doors.note: Nav links 'New York Store' to two page slugs (1265 and 1283 Madison Ave); both say 'We've moved up the block! Come visit us at 1283 Madison Avenue' — one store. No ZIP or phone on page. Stockist feed 293 wholesale rows, none Cara Cara-named. Search results also show look-alike domains (caracarachic.com, caracaranycshop.shop, caracarastyle.com) — likely not official, ignored.

craft_evidence.owned: no — 'ethically-operated workrooms in the US, and WRAP-certified factories in India, China and Peru', none named
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded 2019 in New York by Julia Brown, Katie Hobbs and Sasha Martin; Madison Avenue stores
craft_evidence.process: thin — prints designed in-house or adapted from vintage textiles; factories vetted each season and 'each piece hand sewn by small teams'
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every product page states its country (China or India), and the story page names the production countries and WRAP certification. No factory or maker is named, and the US workrooms it mentions don't appear on any sampled product, so it's a 2.
